message: the IV material was not observed to come from a randomized source
unique_msg: com.vitorpamplona.amethyst.commons.model.preferences.SecretEncryption:::decrypt:::GCMParameterSpecSpec:::UnsatisfiedConstraint:::the IV material was not observed to come from a randomized source
detector_site_kind: NOBS: a required origin was not observed (not a positive contradiction)
detector_label_meaning: NOT OBSERVED: the runtime monitor tracks the producers a rule requires by object identity within one process, and saw none for this object. No admitted producer was seen (e.g. SecureRandom for an IV, salt or seed; Key.getEncoded() for key bytes). The monitor cannot tell innocent cases -- bytes read back from storage, an IV parsed from the ciphertext, a producer it does not see -- from the defective one: bytes that are constants compiled into the application or derived from constants. Where the bytes come from decides it.
detector_runtime_observation: Reported in 2 run(s) of the app; each run starts from a clean, read-only emulator. Fingerprint of the byte[] material (vfp; the value itself is not logged): 4 distinct value(s) over 2 reporting run(s). One value across runs means constant material on this one emulated device; varying values mean bytes generated or read at run time.
detector_echoes: IvChainJunctionSpec IVCHAINJUNCTION-NOBS-07 (upstream-refused, 2 run(s)): the AlgorithmParameterSpec given to Cipher.init was already reported where it was constructed
